Goodhart's Law vs "prediction markets" (permalink) The most selectively believed-in verse in the conservative catechism is the idea that "incentives matter." Sure, "incentives matter" if you're seeking healthcare. That's why you're nibbled to death by co-pays and deductibles – if you could get healthcare whenever you felt like it, you might get too much healthcare.
